select t.task_id as taskId, o.transfer_id as transferId, o.order_no as orderNo, o.from_dept_id as fromDeptId, o.from_dept_name as fromDeptName, o.to_dept_id as toDeptId, o.to_dept_name as toDeptName, t.node_name as nodeName, o.status as status, o.total_quantity as totalQuantity, o.total_amount as totalAmount, o.transfer_type as transferType, o.submitted_time as submittedTime, o.create_time as createTime from inv_transfer_approval_task t inner join inv_transfer_order o on o.transfer_id = t.transfer_id inner join inv_transfer_approval_instance i on i.instance_id = t.instance_id and i.transfer_id = o.transfer_id and i.status = 'running' where t.status = 'pending' and t.node_order = i.current_node_order and o.status = 'submitted' and find_in_set(#{candidateUserId}, t.candidate_user_ids)
order by o.submitted_time desc, o.create_time desc, t.task_id desc
